about: A self-hosted notes app that keeps notes as plain Markdown files.

prs.title: Quoted tags count as the same tag
prs.broken: Tags written with quotes kept the quotes, so the same tag showed up twice and the tag filter missed notes.
prs.changed: One pair of quotes is now removed from each tag, on the server and in the browser.
prs.matters: Vaults brought in from other tools, which often quote tags, filter correctly.

prs.title: The graph shows links to notes created later
prs.broken: A link to a note that didn't exist yet never showed in the graph after the note was created, until a restart.
prs.changed: Creating a note now resolves links that other notes already have to it.
prs.matters: Clicking a missing link to create the note shows the connection in the graph right away.
